content: Urum Babel ta uteene isala kat
Muŋgu zin tomtom ta timbot su toono na, zin ta boozomen kalŋan tamen.
Mi zin tizirri zin ma tilala pa zoŋ uunu, to tindeeŋe lele keteeneŋana ta, ta imbot pa lele pakaana ki Sinar, mi tipun su tana.

To timaŋga mi tiparso pizin ta kembei: “Lak! Kozo totooro toono sa mi teneene pa you be ipet ma iwe kembei ta pat mbolŋana i.” Tana tikam ta kembei, to len koroŋ be tipo ruumu mbolŋana pa. Mi tikam koroŋ toro kembei ta zim i, be ikis pat tana ma imbol.

To timaŋga mi tiso: “Lak! Kozo iti tuur lende kar biibi sa, mi topo urum tau uteene isala ma koŋsala saamba. Naso zanda iwe biibi. Mi koroŋ toro tomini. Uraata biibi tiŋgi ko ilup ti ma tewe tamen. Kokena tumureege ma tombot leŋaleŋa irao toono ta boozomen.”
To Merere isu be ilou zin, mibe ire kar biibi mi urum tau tomtom tiwwo ma uteene isala ta kor a.
Tabe iso: “Wae! Zin tomtom tau tilup ma tiwe tamen kek. Mi tiso kalŋan tamen. Mi iŋgi timaŋga pa uraata biibi ta tiŋgi tomini. Tana kaimer ko matan pasom uraata bibip ta boozomen.
Kozo tusula mi totooro kalŋan ma iwe ndelndelŋa. Naso tapakankaana zin ma irao tiparleŋ kalŋan mini som.”
Tona Merere iyaŋgwiiri zin mi tiko papirik ma tirao pa lele ta boozomen. Tana tizem uraata biibi tana ma imborene.
Kar biibi tana, tipaata zaana be ‘Babel.’ Paso, indeeŋe ta tomtom ta boozomen timbotmbot tana na, Merere itooro kalŋan bekena ipakankaana zin, mi iyaŋgwiiri zin ma tila tirao pa toono ta boozomen.
Sem popoŋana kini
Sem popoŋana kini tipet ta kembei: Indeeŋe nonor biibi imap mi ndaama ru ilae na, Sem ipeebe pikin tomooto ta, zaana Apaksat. Mazwaana tana Sem ndaama kini irao 100 kek.
Apaksat isu, to Sem imbot pa ndaama 500 tomen, mi ipeebe pikin pakan, mana imeete.
Apaksat ndaama kini irao 35, to ipeebe pikin tomooto ta, zaana Sela.
Sela isu to Apaksat imbot pa ndaama 403 tomen, mi ipeebe pikin pakan, mana imeete.
Sela ndaama kini irao 30, to ipeebe pikin tomooto ta, zaana Eber.
Eber isu, to Sela imbot pa ndaama 403 tomen, mi ipeebe pikin pakan, mana imeete.
Eber ndaama kini irao 34, to ipeebe pikin tomooto ta, zaana Pelek.
Pelek isu, to Eber imbot pa ndaama 430 tomen, mi ipeebe pikin pakan, mana imeete.
Pelek ndaama kini irao 30, to ipeebe pikin tomooto ta, zaana Reu.
Reu isu, to Pelek imbot pa ndaama 209 tomen, mi ipeebe pikin pakan, mana imeete.
Reu ndaama kini irao 32, to ipeebe pikin tomooto ta, zaana Seruk.
Seruk isu, to Reu imbot pa ndaama 207 tomen, mi ipeebe pikin pakan, mana imeete.
Seruk ndaama kini irao 30, to ipeebe pikin tomooto ta, zaana Naor.
Naor isu, to Seruk imbot pa ndaama 200 tomen, mi ipeebe pikin pakan, mana imeete.
Naor ndaama kini irao 29, to ipeebe pikin tomooto ta, zaana Tera.
Tera isu, to Naor imbot pa ndaama 119 tomen, mi ipeebe pikin pakan, mana imeete.
Tera ndaama kini irao 70, to ipeebe lutuunu bizin tel ta zan Abaram, Naor, mi Aran.
Mbol ki Tera
Iŋgi Tera ziŋan popoŋana kini mbol kizin: Tera ipeebe Abaram, Naor, mi Aran. Aran, ni ipeebe Lot.
Aran tamaana Tera imbotbot men, mi Aran imeete su kar kini Ur, ta imbot la lele pakaana biibi ki Kaldia na.
Abaram iwoolo Sarai, mi Naor iwoolo Milka. Milka ziru Iska taman ta Aran.
Mi Sarai, ni kopo somŋana, tana ipeebe pikin som.

Tera, ni ikam lutuunu Abaram, mi tumbuunu Lot, ta Aran lutuunu na, mi rwoono moori Sarai, ta Abaram kusiini na, ma ziŋan tizem kar Ur tau imbot la lele pakaana ki Kaldia na, mi tisombe tila pa toono Kanaan. Tamen tipet kar Aran, to tipun su mi timbot tana.
Indeeŋe Tera ndaama kini irao 205, to imeete su kar tana.
